paragraphs.text: Pontotoc will play Baldwyn at 3 p.m. Tuesday, Nov. 24, in the Booneville Thanksgiving Tournament, according to the holiday schedule posted by Pontotoc Athletics. The boys’ game follows Pontotoc’s 1:30 p.m. girls game against Center Hill, giving Warriors fans two games in the same afternoon.

The school flyer fills in the opponent and tipoff that were still blank on the boys’ online schedule when Pontotoc News checked it Saturday. The Warriors open the tournament Monday against Florence of Alabama at 4:30 p.m. The Baldwyn game is the second of their two days in Booneville.

Both Pontotoc teams come in off road wins at Tupelo. The girls won 57–40 and enter the holiday week 4–1. The boys won 59–54 for their second straight victory and are 3–1. After the Booneville games, the boys face Grissom of Alabama at 11:30 a.m. Friday in the Lighthouse Classic at Corinth.
